messages.text: Quality and production teams needs one defensible decision for plated busbar receipt by 2026-01-13; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside effective plan, lot, supplier, characteristic, and sample-size table.
I found 111 EA on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0051 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000051 up to 106 EA, provided effective plan, lot, supplier, characteristic, and sample-size table. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or inspect_entire_unrelated_receipt.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for lab inspection capacity is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R8 and the CASE-052 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-051.

Required closeout records: prepare the reply in the existing email thread and leave it as a draft for review; do not send it; and post the decided option, date, constraint, alternatives, and Oracle reference in the existing operations thread. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
